full_page.content:
Page 54 Cont.
June 15th Geo. Rodenbach - 52 - kidney trouble would like to go to Ann Arbor ... but.
Joseph Mallock - 36 - Accident 28 March ... peculiar fracture of scull; has family of three .... never baptized .... Enrolled To-day.
Mrs. Mary Churilla - 31 - leakage of heart since 14 yrs. of age .... Carried in To-day and Enrolled 3rd time. .
Mrs. Elva Kotcher - 57 - down 4 mos. diabetis ... Drs. fear amputation of foot necessary ....
Page 55 June 22nd
Rachael DeSaele - 40 - gall-stone, fever, operations - one after other Anna E. Cole - 49 - Toledo - What seems to be cancer of breast .... August Formiller - 41 - abandoning religion and family of four. ... Fred Sauthers - 12 - after effects of scarlet Fever .....
Clyde Prince - 11 - spinal man'tis when three yrs. old, deaf ever since - when 8 he went to holy Communion with the other children - Mother worried about it because he had taken no instructions before. Every summer he gets sore hands; Last summer, however, was enrolled in S. Mass A. and the hands were O.K. Enrolled again To-day against fur- ther trouble with hands.
John Ferguson - 50 - stroke a year last month left him quite helpless for six months. Recently is able to be up and around but no use of left arm.
Levina Carrier - 6 - 200 miles beyond Toronto - crippled leg since birth. ....
Dominic Riede - losing sight, asks for his intention. His d'n
Page 56 June 21 Robert Malloy - 24 - of Glasgo Scotl'd .... kidney trouble ... Enrolled 50¢ Aug. 8, '39 "A Mericle!" reported. Home in Ireland - going back work in Sept. Aug. 11 Recovering. Deo Grat. See Aug. 8, 1939
